notes: Counts are dynamic HTML sinks only: an innerHTML/outerHTML assignment whose right-hand side is not an empty or substitution-free literal, a compound += assignment, or an insertAdjacentHTML/document.write call.
Clearing assignments and reviewed constant templates are classified separately and are not counted.
Counts must match exactly. An increase is a regression; a decrease means the pin must be lowered in the change that earned it.
This ratchet is a drift guard, not a safety proof. Rendered-DOM tests carry the security argument.
A file with zero dynamic sinks may be pinned at 0 to lock in a completed repair.
